findings.claim: In the string-key branch of the second member loop (field/property pass), the guard is inverted: `if (stringMembers.ContainsKey(...)) Add(...)` instead of `!ContainsKey`. Members are never added when the key is new, and a duplicate key triggers Add, which throws ArgumentException. This is the analyzer-crash path the change is meant to fix, and it also drops all string-keyed members from the collected type info.
